items.title: Inventory current cross-system architecture and contracts
items.origin: User Phase 0 checklist and forensic discovery

items.next_action: Inventory complete; preserve this baseline and defer runtime contract changes to the gated Phase 1.

items.title: Characterize critical RAG, provenance, failure, concurrency, and recovery behavior
items.origin: User Phase 0 characterization requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Representative document, chunk, embedding, persistence/index, known-query evidence, grounded answer, provenance, malformed/provider/vector failures, duplicate, restart, and concurrency behavior are recorded as pass/fail/not-run.
items.next_action: Characterization matrix complete; run NOT_RUN paths only after the listed environment prerequisites are provisioned.

items.title: Capture executable performance and reproducibility baseline
items.origin: User Phase 0 performance baseline requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Environment, commands, ingestion/embedding/query/retrieval/generation latency, TTFT where applicable, memory, index size, duplicate, and concurrency measurements are saved or explicitly marked NOT_RUN.
items.next_action: Baseline artifact complete; rerun the conditional live measurements after environment provisioning.

items.title: Publish Phase 0 report, status, risks, and proposed Phase 1 layout
items.origin: User Phase 0 report and handoff requirements
items.acceptance_summary: The required phase report sections, PHASE 0 STATUS table, VERIFIED_CANDIDATE recommendation decision, limitations, and evidence-backed Phase 1 implementation plan are complete.
items.next_action: Await human acceptance of the partial/non-promoted report and resolution of its open environment gates; do not start Phase 1.

items.title: Provision and characterize the reproducible Phase 0.5 runtime baseline
items.origin: User Phase 0.5 runtime baseline and control task requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Pinned Python/uv/Qdrant/Redis/Node/npm versions, isolated services, repaired frontend lockfile, reproducible commands, and honest A–O status evidence are captured without host-state mutation.
items.next_action: Capture the versioned environment artifact and run the isolated CVG, Professor, Locker, frontend, and Qdrant checks; mark unavailable provider paths explicitly.

items.title: Freeze and implement the canonical versioned RAG contract
items.origin: User Phase 0.5 canonical RAG contract requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Canonical collection resolution, named vectors, complete payload, deterministic IDs, RetrievalContext, compatibility adapters, schema fixtures, and idempotent document identity are implemented and tested.
items.next_action: Add the contract document and focused model/vector/ingestion tests after the runtime baseline is recorded.

items.title: Make distributed Redis locking owner-safe and failure-clean
items.origin: User Phase 0.5 Redis lock ownership and cleanup requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Acquire, owner-bound compare-delete unlock, optional renewal, expiry, contention, wrong-owner, and Professor finally-release behavior are proven with isolated Redis evidence.
items.next_action: Implement the Locker contract and Professor release path once the canonical context interface is stable.

items.title: Close Professor evidence-gate and citation integrity defects
items.origin: User Phase 0.5 evidence and provenance requirements
items.acceptance_summary: No/weak/approved evidence states are explicit; weak single hits fall back; planner IDs are validated against authorized retrieved chunks; fabricated, wrong, inaccessible, and nonretrieved citations are rejected.
items.next_action: Add the evidence resolver and negative tests in Professor after RetrievalContext is available.

items.title: Harden upload paths, filenames, collisions, and diagnostic hygiene
items.origin: User Phase 0.5 upload and secret/log hygiene requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Traversal, absolute paths, NULs, unsupported extensions, size limits, and collisions are handled safely; storage names are generated; logs and errors do not expose secrets or raw connection URLs.
items.next_action: Implement safe filename/storage helpers and focused API tests.

items.title: Implement canonical identity, RBAC, session lifecycle, and audit events
items.origin: User Phase 0.5 identity and role model requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Canonical roles and permissions with legacy aliases, strong password hashing, disabled/logout/session invalidation, rate limits, generic failures, explicit route authorization, and audit events are implemented.
items.next_action: Add canonical authorization helpers and route-level negative tests while preserving legacy API compatibility.

items.title: Enforce workspace and collection ACLs at retrieval and source boundaries
items.origin: User Phase 0.5 collection ownership and non-leak requirements
items.acceptance_summary: RetrievalContext is required at server-side filters; veterinarians see only granted collections; managers/admins receive the documented scope; documents, sources, and citations cannot cross ACLs.
items.next_action: Wire authorized collection IDs through CVG retrieval, Professor requests, and source/citation responses.

items.title: Run integrated Phase 0.5 verification, independent critique, and promotion decision
items.origin: User Phase 0.5 promotion gate and gauntlet requirements
items.acceptance_summary: All required runtime, contract, security, E2E, regression, concurrency, performance, and independent-review evidence is current and the final status is one of the allowed honest outcomes.
items.next_action: Resolve the explicit provider, historical fixture/policy, and deployment-control gaps before reopening VERIFIED; keep Phase 1 deferred.

items.title: Reconcile the published commit and initialize Phase 0.6 closure control plane
items.origin: Phase 0.6 Promotion Closure requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Published Phase 0.5 SHA, current Git state, active Phase 0.6 plan/task, backlog and append-only ledgers are structurally aligned and checked by an executable control-plane validator.
items.next_action: Control-plane checker passed; Phase 0.6 implementation lanes are unlocked.

items.title: Close RBAC override semantics, session snapshots, and veterinarian policy
items.origin: Phase 0.6 explicit RBAC and VET access requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Explicit additions/removals and wildcard rules are deterministic, removed permissions are never re-granted, legacy sessions retain immutable effective snapshots until invalidation, and VET source/read/browse boundaries have negative coverage.
items.next_action: RBAC, wildcard, session-snapshot, VET and route-negative checks passed; retain the canonical permission registry as the review point.

items.title: Classify and resolve the complete CVG legacy red surface
items.origin: Phase 0.6 explicit legacy test classification requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Every baseline failure/error has a test ID, file, failure text, root cause, allowed classification, relevance, action/evidence and final status; no unexplained red or hidden tests remain.
items.next_action: Restore the approved corpus with provenance or record an owner-authorized permanent waiver, then rerun the full suite without masking.

items.title: Exercise the real OpenAI-compatible provider contract
items.origin: Phase 0.6 real provider contract requirements
items.acceptance_summary: A real configured provider or real loopback OpenAI-compatible HTTP server covers success and all required provider failures with safe errors, bounded retry, correlation, state integrity, citation integrity and lock cleanup.
items.next_action: Local real-protocol contract passed; obtain live-provider evidence only with approved endpoint and credentials.

items.title: Enforce Locker internal boundary and integrated CI lanes
items.origin: Phase 0.6 deployment boundary and CI requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Locker is private-network-only in deployment examples with a lint/test guard, and CI enforces pinned fast/integration checks for all relevant component, security, contract, frontend, secret, dependency and control-plane surfaces.
items.next_action: Boundary lint, component tests, dependency audits and workflow structure passed; execute GitHub lanes when published.

items.title: Integrate Phase 0.6 evidence and prepare the final gate
items.origin: Phase 0.6 report and final-gate requirements
items.acceptance_summary: Required report, provider/legacy baselines, control-plane reconciliation, regression/security results and final gate accurately reflect current executable evidence.
items.next_action: Integrated report, baselines, final gate and control references are complete; retain BLOCKED until corpus/waiver and external evidence are resolved.
